title: CRD default broke the upgrade hook undetected because the upgrade e2e path filter missed CRD sources

source.reference: https://github.com/pando85/kaniop/pull/1112 added credentialBootstrapDelivery (default: event) to the person CRD. The CRD Migration E2E workflow only ran on migration paths, so it never ran on master afterwards; the plural migration hook then failed on every upgrade with 4 checksum mismatches (backups lacked the field, restored objects were defaulted by the API server). Last green run before the escape: 2026-10-24. Found while preparing #1120.

required_properties: The CRD upgrade e2e workflow triggers on every file that defines a CRD type generated by cmd/crdgen (libs/person/src/crd.rs, libs/group/src/crd.rs, libs/oauth2/src/crd.rs, libs/service-account/src/crd.rs, libs/backup-core/src/crd.rs, libs/operator/src/kanidm/crd.rs, libs/operator/src/kanidm/restore/legacy.rs), on cmd/crdgen/**, cmd/crd-migrator/**, charts/**, and on the workflow and its scripts

Because charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml is generated and not committed, the trigger also covers the dependency manifests (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, libs/*/Cargo.toml) whose types are embedded in the CRD schemas

The upgrade e2e starts from a published release and proves that the current generated CRDs reached the cluster through the crdApply hook (for example by comparing live CRD specs with charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml after the hook overwrote a deliberately stale copy)
The upgrade e2e checks that objects created before the upgrade still reconcile and that new objects with server-side defaulted fields become Ready after it
The explanation names the trigger gap as the root cause of the escape, not only the checksum comparison
forbidden_changes: Fix only the checksum comparison and leave the upgrade e2e path filter unable to see CRD source changes
Trigger the upgrade e2e only from hand-maintained lists of migration files
Disable or skip the crdApply hook in the upgrade test to make it pass
Hand-edit charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml or files under examples/
